description.en:
Our steam cleaners deliver high-temperature steam up to 140°C to sanitize and deep-clean surfaces without chemicals. Perfect for kitchens, bathrooms, floors, and upholstery, they eliminate 99.9% of bacteria and germs naturally.

Each model features rapid 30-second heat-up, continuous steam control, and a comprehensive accessory kit for versatile cleaning. The detachable handheld mode converts the unit for portable use, covering every corner of your home.

As an OEM/ODM partner, we offer custom color matching, logo printing, and tailored packaging. MOQ 300 units with a 25-35 day production lead time.
description.zh:
我们的蒸汽清洁机可产生高达140°C的高温蒸汽，无需化学清洁剂即可消毒和深层清洁表面。适用于厨房、浴室、地板和布艺家具，天然消除99.9%的细菌。

每款机型配备30秒快速加热、持续蒸汽控制和全套配件，实现多功能清洁。可拆卸手持模式将主机转换为便携设备，覆盖家中每个角落。

作为OEM/ODM合作伙伴，我们提供定制配色、Logo印刷和专属包装。最小起订量300台，大货交期25-35天。
